stories.headline: Anthropic raises a further $12.2B via greenshoe, taking its IPO total to $93.5B; stock closes down 8.5% on day two
stories.quote: ANTHROPIC RAISES AN ADDITIONAL $12.2B AS UNDERWRITERS EXERCISE THEIR “GREENSHOE” OVERALLOTMENT OF SHARES, BRINGING THE TOTAL RAISED IN ITS IPO TO $93.5B

facts.text: Underwriters exercised the greenshoe overallotment, adding $12.2B and bringing the IPO total to $93.5B.
facts.quote: ANTHROPIC RAISES AN ADDITIONAL $12.2B AS UNDERWRITERS EXERCISE THEIR “GREENSHOE” OVERALLOTMENT OF SHARES, BRINGING THE TOTAL RAISED IN ITS IPO TO $93.5B

facts.text: On its second day of trading the stock closed down 8.5% at $88.91.
facts.quote: ANTHROPIC STOCK CLOSED DOWN 8.5% AT $88.91 ON ITS SECOND DAY OF TRADING, TRIMMING GAINS FROM ITS $83 IPO PRICE

facts.text: The IPO price was $83 per share.
facts.quote: TRIMMING GAINS FROM ITS $83 IPO PRICE

facts.text: Asian tech stocks fell despite the record IPO: SoftBank ~15%, TSMC 5%+, Samsung and SK Hynix 6%+.

stories.headline: NYT: current and former staff describe decades of abusive behaviour by Jensen Huang; Nvidia settled with two senior leaders
stories.quote: CURRENT AND EX-STAFFERS DESCRIBE ABUSIVE BEHAVIOR BY JENSEN HUANG THAT GOES BACK DECADES; NVIDIA SETTLED WITH TWO SENIOR LEADERS WHO ALLEGED ABUSIVE CONDUCT

facts.text: Sources say the board's main reason for ousting Huang was lying and lack of candor over the Alice Huang affair.
facts.quote: SOURCES: NVIDIA BOARD'S MAIN REASON FOR OUSTING JENSEN HUANG WAS HIS “LYING” AND “LACK OF CANDOR” FROM OCTOBER 2025 UNTIL THIS FALL OVER THE ALICE HUANG AFFAIR

facts.text: Trump said he would love to see Huang return as CEO.
facts.quote: TRUMP SAYS HE “WOULD LOVE TO SEE” JENSEN HUANG RETURN AS CEO, SAYING “IF THEY WERE SMART”, NVIDIA WOULD “ACCEPT AN APOLOGY, AND LET HIM GO BACK TO WORK”

stories.headline: Sources: the US SEC is probing Nvidia's accounting practices
stories.quote: SOURCES: THE US SEC IS PROBING NVIDIA'S ACCOUNTING PRACTICES; LAST YEAR, NVIDIA CHANGED HOW IT REPORTS REVENUE, REMOVING SINGAPORE FROM GEOGRAPHICAL BREAKDOWNS

facts.text: California's AG subpoenaed Nvidia over whether Huang's actions resulted in China getting advanced chips and whether investors were misled.
facts.quote: CALIFORNIA'S AG SUBPOENAS NVIDIA TO INVESTIGATE WHETHER JENSEN HUANG'S ACTIONS RESULTED IN CHINA GETTING ADVANCED CHIPS, AND WHETHER NVIDIA MISLED INVESTORS
